lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters are arranged in a multi-columnar grid pattern posterior to the branchial region. These centroids form a semi-regular lattice with approximately equidistant spacing within vertical columns along the lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the circular high-luminance blobs. These vertical stripes serve as alignment axes, creating distinct grid-like anchor nodes where the spots are centered within the lighter vertical bands.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear ridge is visible along the upper-mid flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient in pixel intensity, with specular highlights on the superior edge and a defined shadow on the inferior edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin silhouette contains approximately 7 to 9 distinct high-luminance blobs. These spots are distributed primarily along the anterior and basal regions of the fin, with lower density towards the posterior margin.

other_distinctive_markers: Two Echeneidae individuals (remoras) are visible attached to the shark's ventral-lateral surface; one is positioned posterior to the pectoral fin and the second is further posterior near the lower flank.
